verdict.rationale: Obsidian stores notes as local plain-text Markdown files in a user-controlled vault, explicitly marketed as future-proofing against vendor lock-in, with import/export tooling from other apps confirming portability. Community corroboration notes vaults are just folders of files, though one user flags Canvas's JSON format as a step away from pure Markdown. missing for 10: independent long-term archival/durability testing, and clarification on non-Markdown artifacts (Canvas JSON, attachments) staying fully open.
